description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ezreal''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, applying [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and triggering [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects.
description.text: Active: Ezreal fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, applying on-hit effects and triggering on-attack effects.

description2.raw: If ''Mystic Shot'' successfully hits an enemy, the '''current''' cooldowns of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: If Mystic Shot successfully hits an enemy, the current cooldowns of Ezreal's abilities, including Mystic Shot's, are reduced by 1.5 seconds.

leveling.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 (+ 130% AD) (+ 40% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Mystic Shot'' deals [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]], but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]]. * ''Mystic Shot'' benefits from [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal, [[File:Omnivamp colored icon.svg|20px|link=Vamp#Omnivamp|An icon representing the keyword Omnivamp]] [[:Vamp#Omnivamp|omnivamp]], and [[File:Life steal icon.svg|20px|link=Vamp#Physical vamp|An icon representing the keyword Physical vamp]] [[:Vamp#Physical vamp|physical vamp]], but not [[File:Spell vamp icon.svg|20px|link=Vamp#Spell vamp|An icon representing the keyword Spell vamp]] [[:Vamp#Spell vamp|spell vamp]]. * Even if the ability is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]] it will still trigger the cooldown reduction. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * ''Mystic Shot'' will be buffered and cast when the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within 0.05 seconds of the cooldown ending.
notes.text:
Mystic Shot deals basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
Mystic Shot benefits from  life steal, omnivamp, and physical vamp, but not spell vamp.
Even if the ability is blocked by spell shield it will still trigger the cooldown reduction.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Mystic Shot will be buffered and cast when the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within 0.05 seconds of the cooldown ending.
